Changes.note: When you rate a card “Zor”, “Orta” or “Kolay”, your rating is saved and the server decides when the card comes back: Zor after a day, Orta after at least three days and the last gap, Kolay counts the card as learned and brings it back after at least a week, twice the last gap; no card waits longer than 180 days. You alone see your progress; on a course deck the course’s staff see the share of learned cards. A rating is not taken back; you rate the card again when it comes back. If you study without signing in, nothing is saved.
Public.note: If you study without signing in, your progress is not saved.
